interpretation: Error reduction, nRMSE and R2 are monotonic transforms of the same quantity RMSE/SD; they cannot serve as independent validation of one another. Only absolute RMSE and prediction-observation rank correlation add information, and the latter still correlates with label SD.
reporting_rule: Do not place error_reduction_pct or R2 in the abstract, title or figure caption as a primary result. Report SD, absolute RMSE and rank rho together, and state the shared dependence on label SD in Limitations.
